newsitem.title: USA: Video Lottery to review purchase offer.
newsitem.headline: Video Lottery to review purchase offer.

text.p: Video Lottery Technologies Inc said Monday it wanted to evaluate an offer made by Spier Group to buy shares in the company at $6 each before making a final decision.

"We welcome the Spier proposal and are prepared to consider it seriously," it said. "At the same time, the Special Committee of the Board is waiting for Mr. (William) Spier to respond to certain basic questions."
Video said it wanted to know how the group planned to finance the purchase and how it will get regulatory approval, among other things.
It also said it was "considering other options and all proposals".
Spier, a New York investor, said last week he had written to the company's committee, asking it to consider his offer.
Spier is a director of the company and leader of the group that already owns 14.4 percent of Video Lottery.
